name: HB Token
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: The HB Token contract on BNB Chain was exploited on April 7, 2026 for approximately $193K. No public post-mortem, media coverage, or detailed security firm analysis has been published for this incident. The specific vulnerability exploited in the token contract has not been publicly disclosed. Attack Tx: 0x19671f5781acc3f5e3a869491a880aa9ee894911f4898a43254fa942d71594ed
